answer: Require each agent identity to lock a meaningful stake before it can transact, like a basalt foundation under an orchard: the stake stays frozen while the agent works and is slashed for fraud. An attacker who wants a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand separate stakes, so the cost scales linearly instead of staying near zero, while honest agents keep their deposit if they behave. This turns identity creation from a free copy-paste into a ledge where every extra identity demands real capital at risk.
